patch_checks.why: the reference fix with every escape turned into a sanitiser that drops quotes, backticks and ${ (backslashes still escaped): blocks every injection but alters description values; scored 1.0 before the round-trip functional tests were added (2026-10-20)

the reference fix but three sinks drop the delimiter instead of escaping it (single quotes removed from quoted mock keys and from the server-framework route literal; alternative-output object-default keys reduced to identifier characters): nothing executes, but the attack values are altered, which the security tests' round-trip assertions catch (2026-10-21); functional tests cannot, since the vulnerable code cannot carry those delimiters
fresh agent, report + repo only (written after this build)

wrong_fix_catalogue.refuse_all: n/a: there is no refusal channel; a generator that rejects descriptions with special characters leaves security tests without an artifact (failure) and the functional round-trip tests fail too
wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: generation errors leave no generated artifact, so the module-level security checks error out rather than pass
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: each guard acts on the exact literal being emitted; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: string escaping has no peer/role/direction dimension; every sink is covered by its own test
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: there is no read/write split in a code generator
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the input is arbitrary text, not an identity that a parser could normalise differently
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: escaping is local to each emitter; no external authority can return empty
